subject: Vendor inventory & onward-transfer permissions — BrightBank request
messages:
From: Elena Sorensen <elena.sorensen@brightbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Compliance <compliance@brightbank.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightbank.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: current vendor roster + onward-transfer permissions

Hi Rishi,

Following our procurement review, BrightBank needs an up-to-date vendor roster (subprocessor list) that shows all third parties Redwood uses to process customer data for the Redwood API and Redwood Dedicated offerings. In particular, we need to confirm: 

- Any onward transfers of personal data outside the EEA (country list + legal basis, e.g., SCCs)
- Which subprocessors have been added in the last 12 months and whether those additions have been approved by your customers or are covered by your standard DPA
- Whether there are any plans to engage new subprocessors (e.g., cloud infra, logging, vector DBs) in the next 90 days

Separately, BrightBank has a policy that requires explicit customer-level permission for any onward transfer to certain high-risk categories (analytics providers, offshore model-hosting, or third-party vector indexing services). Please indicate whether Redwood will: 1) grant BrightBank a standing permission for specified subprocessors, or 2) require BrightBank to approve each new subprocessor via amendment. If you require amendments, please indicate estimated lead time and any docs you need from us.

Could you send the vendor roster and any supporting dataflow/matrix by EOD Tuesday 05/18? If possible, include the last SOC 2 / SIG summary for any new vendors we should be concerned about.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Sorensen
Senior Information Risk Manager | BrightBank

--
Attachment: none (please attach vendor CSV or link)

Subject: Re: Request: current vendor roster + onward-transfer permissions

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching our canonical vendor inventory (CSV) and a current dataflow matrix (xlsx). Quick notes up front:

- Onward transfers: Redwood uses SCCs for transfers from the EEA to the US for infrastructure providers. We list the relevant countries and SSC execution status in column G of the CSV.
- Recent additions (past 12 months): Quantio Labs (vector indexing), ClearStore (log archiving), and NimbusMetrics (analytics). Details and risk tier are in the "RiskTier" column.
- Planned vendors (next 90 days): potential pilot with VectorCloud for a caching/also-quantized model cache — this is NOT yet contracted.

Requesting laura and neha to confirm whether we can provide BrightBank a standing permission for low-risk infra vendors (IaaS, CDN, KMS) and ask for guidance on any conditional approvals for analytics/vector services.

Action items I'd like to surface:
1) Laura: confirm policy for standing permissions vs per-vendor amendment.
2) Neha: can you pull SOC 2/SIG summaries for Quantio Labs and VectorCloud and drop into the Drive link below?
3) Elena/Tom: if you prefer amendments, share your DocuSign or counterparty workflow and a sample clause you require for SCC/DPA updates.

Drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/vendor-inventory-2026-05-15
Attachments: vendor_inventory_20260515.csv, dataflow_matrix_v2.xlsx

Regards,

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: current vendor roster + onward-transfer permissions

Rishi / Neha —

Reviewed the inventory and the planned pilots. My guidance for BrightBank:

- Standing permission: approve for core infra categories only (IaaS providers, standard CDNs, managed KMS) — we can provide BrightBank a one-line standing consent for those named vendors (see CSV, rows tagged "infra").
- Conditional approvals: deny blanket/standing permission for analytics, vector-indexing, and model-caching vendors (Quantio Labs, VectorCloud) pending:
  * SIG questionnaire completion (or equivalent SOC 2 + penetration test summary)
  * Dataflow detail showing whether BrightBank data is pseudonymized prior to indexing and retention periods
- If customer requests per-vendor amendments: we can support DPA amendments but need a minimum 10 business-day review window plus security evidence. For high-risk vendors we may require a 30 business-day security review and a contract addendum.

Neha: please compile SOC2/SIG summaries for Quantio Labs and VectorCloud and upload by EOD today so we can reply to BrightBank with the right ask. Rishi: communicate the standing vs conditional stance and request BrightBank's preferred workflow for amendments (DocuSign link/procurement ticket).

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: current vendor roster + onward-transfer permissions

Elena / Tom —

Thanks for your patience. Please find attached our vendor inventory (vendor_inventory_20260515.csv) and dataflow matrix (dataflow_matrix_v2.xlsx). To summarize Redwood's stance: 

- We can provide BrightBank a standing permission limited to core infrastructure subprocessors (IaaS, CDN, KMS) named in the CSV. 
- We cannot grant a blanket standing permission for analytics/vector-indexing/model-caching vendors. For Quantio Labs and VectorCloud we require either: (a) SIG/SOC2 evidence + dataflow confirmation that BrightBank data will not be indexed without consent, or (b) a DPA amendment that specifically names the subprocessor and sets retention limits.

Next steps we propose:
1) BrightBank confirms whether you want a standing permission for infra vendors. If yes, we will send a short consent clause you can sign (DocuSign preferred).
2) For Quantio/VectorCloud: BrightBank to provide a preferred review flow (DocuSign amendment or procurement ticket). If you choose amendment route, please allow 10 business days for a review; if you want expedited review we can prioritize but will need security evidence (SIG/SOC2).

Neha has been asked to upload SOC 2 / SIG summaries to the Drive link; Laura has approved the limited standing permission approach for infra.

If useful, I can jump on a 30-minute call this week to walk through the CSV and the dataflow matrix. Would Wednesday 05/20 10:00am PT work?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales (Platform) | Redwood Inference
